profile.description: I create innovative and efficient digital experiences using modern .NET and Frontend technologies.

about.paragraph1: I am a Senior Fullstack Developer with over 10 years of experience, specialized in software solutions development primarily using <highlight>.NET</highlight> tools and the <highlight>C#</highlight> programming language.
about.paragraph2: My professional journey includes designing, developing, and implementing scalable, high-quality microservices, applying advanced architectures such as Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and clean code principles.
about.paragraph3: My main strength lies within the .NET ecosystem, where I have extensively worked on developing robust APIs, enterprise applications, and client-oriented systems, optimizing the performance of SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle databases.
about.paragraph4: Additionally, I have a strong interest in Front-End development using tools like the React library, focusing on providing outstanding user experiences through the creation of modern, attractive, and easy-to-use interfaces that combine clean design with robust functionalities.
about.paragraph5: I have collaborated in agile teams under Scrum methodologies, managing tasks with tools like Jira and using version control systems such as Azure Repos and platforms based on Git.
about.paragraph6: I am passionate about learning new technologies and applying this knowledge to create innovative solutions that meet high standards of quality and usability.

projects.title: MY ACCOUNT
projects.functionalDescription: My Account App is an intuitive platform designed to simplify the management and supervision of personal finances in a clear and efficient way. It provides detailed control of income, expenses, and monthly and annual balances, allowing users to keep precise track of their financial situation. The application offers a dynamic dashboard with interactive charts and customization options tailored to each user’s specific needs.
projects.technicalDescription: The application is developed using <highlight>React</highlight> for the frontend, providing a modern and dynamic interface, while the backend is implemented with <highlight>.NET Core 8</highlight>, ensuring robust and scalable performance. Data is efficiently stored in a <highlight>PostgreSQL</highlight> database, guaranteeing secure, reliable management and readiness for scaling at any time.

1.positionDescription: I was part of a support and development team for an application related to the "Factoring and Confirming" business, gathering requirements and adapting solutions to meet specific client needs in Bogotá, Colombia. My work stood out for efficiently implementing integrations that optimized the bank's internal processes.

2.positionDescription: I implemented integrations for the bank's internal systems using Oracle 11g and SQL Server 2008. I developed robust backend solutions while gaining experience with Santander's "Isban" methodology, focusing on system stability and performance.

3.positionDescription: I developed and supported client-oriented intranet systems, optimizing solutions with Oracle 11g and SQL Server 2008. I implemented improvements ensuring deliverable quality and meeting objectives by following agile Scrum methodologies.

4.positionDescription: I was part of a development and maintenance team for academic management systems "Omega" using .NET Framework, React, and SQL Server. I designed and implemented complex business logic based on customized client requirements under agile (Scrum) and waterfall methodologies. I enhanced user experience by creating modern and efficient interfaces that optimized the use of academic systems.

5.positionDescription: I developed and implemented microservices using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) architecture with .NET Core 7, improving system scalability. I worked with SQL, PostgreSQL, and MySQL databases, ensuring optimal performance. I used collaboration tools like Bitbucket and Zoho Projects for project management.

6.positionDescription: As a Senior Backend .NET Developer, I have designed and developed scalable microservices using .NET Framework 4.8, significantly optimizing system performance and improving deployment efficiency through the implementation of CI/CD pipelines. I use advanced tools like Azure Repos for version control and Jira for task management.
